what: The model per run (GET /api/v1/agent runtime.model_split, model_decide, model_routine): with the switch on every run of a Claude Code command gets --model of its kind -- model_decide for the person's chat messages, buttons, reactions, comments, team messages and every unknown event, and for a job wake with a hard sign (the job did not end done, messages for it came too late, its result is not in the chat, it asks something or shows an approval card, an open decision, a hard red: failed / blocked / a security finding in a line that is not a story, soft or negated); model_routine for job wakes without one, new tasks (task_added, tasks_added, tidy), follow-ups (stale_tasks, followup_due) and planned jobs without a sign word. An empty field = the agent's model. One conversation per person, the model changes per run inside it (a new one only when the settings change); a switch that fails early runs once more on the conversation's previous model, which then stays for an hour. The run's log line names the model and the reason. 2.992.0 (#5684): a third kind, reviews (runtime model_review, empty = model_decide) for what the trigger says is a review - review_requested and a planned job with review: true (the plan's kind Review, every scheduled check of a project) -, never a word in a text; one event that needs a decision in the same run wins. The usage hook gets the run's kind and id (KALMIDO_RUN_CLASS, KALMIDO_RUN_ID) and reports them as run_class / run_id (a server before 2.992: again without them), so Kalmido shows usage per kind. 2.1394.0 (#7031): model and effort per kind of job (runtime model_job / effort_job for a build job, model_audit / effort_audit for a review job --audit; empty = the command's own): agent_job.py gives a Claude Code job --model / --effort of its kind at every start, revive and wake #7368: the effort per kind of run (runtime effort with the one model; effort_decide / effort_review / effort_routine with the model per run on, empty = like the model fields' fallback): every run of a Claude Code command gets --effort of its kind (empty = none, the command's own stays); another command gets none
